method: SoundFile + NumPy + SciPy on all decoded samples of the encoded MP3. Takes trimmed to the span above -50 dBFS (4 ms pre-roll, 40 ms tail), faded, attenuated only when the raw peak exceeded -1.5 dBFS, encoded once with FFmpeg 7.1 libmp3lame 128 kb/s 44.1 kHz stereo; interface takes first get a -4 dB high shelf above 5 kHz. RMS over the active span; loudness = BS.1770 K-weighted, ungated. Variant gain = min(gain to the family target RMS, gain to the family peak ceiling); event gain 1. Arithmetic balance only: no human listening, no mixed-output or distance proof.
